decision_conditions: The requested non-material amendment to planning permission P0076.23 dated 20/03/2023 to allow for the increase of the building height by 500mm is not acceptable.

The amendments sought are considered to materially affect the character and nature of the development previously approved and cannot be regarded as a non-material amendment as the change would alter the appearance, scale and bulk in design terms and its contribution to the wider street scene.
The submission of a fresh planning application is therefore deemed necessary in this case.
description: Application for a non-material amendment to planning permission Ref: P0076.23 dated 20/03/2023 to allow for the increase of the building height by 500mm (Replacement barn following demolition of pre-existing barn)
